subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 9: Get ready for … Pre A1 Starters
outcomes: I can listen and choose the picture with the correct time.
I can look at the clocks before I listen.
I can play a board game and say what time I do things.

tf.s: Before listening, we look at the clocks in the pictures.
tf.why: Yes! Looking first helps us listen.

tf.s: In the listening test, we listen only one time.
A wrong picture shows a time that is different from the recording.
tf.why: Well done! We check the time we hear.

tf.s: Miss a turn means you play two times.
tf.why: Miss a turn means you do not play in the next turn.

tf.s: Go forward two spaces means move your counter two squares ahead.
Go back to 5 means move to square 5.
tf.why: Great! You go back to square 5.

tf.s: Minute hand on 6 and hour hand between 9 and 10 is half past ten.
We answer What time do you get up? with I get up at quarter to six.
tf.why: We use at with a time.

tf.s: Whale and phone both start with wh.
tf.why: Whale starts with wh, phone starts with ph.

tf.s: We say I have dinner at seven o'clock.

boxes.q: What do you look at before listening?
How many times do you listen?
What does Miss a turn mean?
Minute hand on 6, hour hand between 9 and 10.
Complete: I get up ___ six o'clock.
boxes.why: We use at with clock times.

o: What time do you have breakfast?
boxes.why: What time asks for the time.

boxes.q: What do you tick in the listening test?
o: the picture with the right time
boxes.why: Tick the picture that matches what you hear.

boxes.q: Minute hand on 12, hour hand on 7.

mcq.q: What is a good tip before you listen?
o: Look at the clocks in the pictures.
mcq.why: The clocks show you what to listen for.

mcq.q: Which is game language from the board game?
mcq.why: Miss a turn is a board game rule.

mcq.q: Which answer is correct for What time do you have dinner?
o: I have dinner at seven o'clock.
I have dinner in seven o'clock.
I have dinner on seven o'clock.
mcq.why: We use at with a time.

mcq.q: Which phrase do we use when the minute hand is on 3?
You are on square 3. The square says Go forward two spaces. Where do you go?
You are on square 9. The square says Go back to 5. Where do you go?
mcq.why: Go back to 5 means go to square 5.

mcq.q: Minute hand on 9, hour hand just before 8. Which picture do you tick?
mcq.why: On 9 is quarter to, and the next hour is eight.

mcq.q: You hear half past nine. Picture B shows nine o'clock. Why is B wrong?
o: The time on the clock is different.
B is not the first picture.
mcq.why: The clock must show the time you hear.

o: Because the first time is a song.
mcq.why: The second time helps us check.

mcq.q: Square 8 asks wh or ph. Which pair is correct?
mcq.why: Whale has wh and phone has ph.
